notes.title: Minor Update v1.21
notes.notes:
V 1.21 devlog:
-Increased degradation/spoilage of some items like snowballs and some basic raw and cooked meats.
-Changed Keybindings - PAUSE is now P by default, and ESCAPE works for closing chests and shop panels. 
-Player Chests can now be destroyed by any HAMMER. 
-Table can now be disasembled

notes.title: Surviving Skeleton Island - TODAY LIVE ON STEAM! (40% OFF!)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

After 3 years of hard work, lots of learning, making mistakes, figuring things out, listening to my playtesters and improving the game day by day - I'm thrilled to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2287170/Surviving_Skeleton_Island/]Surviving Skeleton Island [/url]has officially launched on Steam! 

To celebrate this release, we're offering a special 40% DISCOUNT for the first week only, so grab it now before the price goes back up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485393/f00459bb25cfcaeaaf68d37ae1af6cc6d208191c.png[/img]

Surviving Skeleton Island is an open world survival crafting RPG set in a primitive 3D low poly island world of 12 unique biomes. Explore, hunt, craft, build, farm and fish to survive, while quests and clues unveil the secrets of the island, and your past. In this challenging, no hands holding, survival game, your choices matter!

[u][b]New in Version 1.2 (MAJOR UPDATE)[/b][/u]

We've been working hard to improve your island survival experience. Here's what's new:

[b]New Combat Mechanics[/b]

-Spirit Essence & Magical Area Damage Orbs: Take on multiple enemies at once with powerful area-of-effect attacks!

[b]Improved Controls[/b]

-Inventory Hotkeys: Press 1-0 on your keyboard to instantly use items in your inventory slots (drink, eat, equip, cook meat, fill jug, etc.)
-Hold to Attack: Simply hold the left mouse button to continuously attack or mine - no more repetitive clicking!

[b]Enhanced Environment[/b]

-Improved pond water appearance
-Added a new pond in the snow area
-Fixed ice chest functionality

-[b]Immersive Audio[/b]

-New eating and drinking sound effects

-Combat Improvements

-Enhanced ranged attack projectile targeting for more precise hits


Come join us on Skeleton Island and see if you have what it takes to survive! 

Please[url=https://discord.gg/dD29kbBEMm] join our DISCORD[/url] and post all your suggestions, I listen to everyone and implement everything I can. 

Don't forget - 40% off for the first week only!

-Bert from Bert Games

notes.title: [Steam Next Fest!] Free Demo Available Now for Skeleton Island
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Survivors!

I am very excited to announce that a fully playable demo of Surviving Skeleton Island is now available to download and play for FREE during Steam Next Fest (February 24 - March 3)! This is your chance to experience the challenging world of survival, crafting, and adventure that awaits you on Skeleton Island.

This is a no-hands-hold game that will challenge you, but still have a fun cozy feel to it with the low poly island vibe. Play the Free Demo Today and see if you can finish it, reaching level 6 or day 14!  Can you be the first one to do it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485393/6ec70b9f5853974abeb194fdda0f9616db054f1f.png[/img]

[b]Latest Updates (v1.0.11):[/b]
I've been hard at work improving the game based on community feedback:

[list]
[*] Enhanced Swimming Mechanics - Completely revamped water system with new drowning mechanics and immersive audio
[*] Pet Summoning System - New whistle feature to call all your pets and horses to your location
[*] Quality of Life - Added an Unstuck button in the pause menu for those tricky situations
[*] Ice Chest Storage - Keep your food fresh longer with the highly requested Ice Chest Fridge
[*] New Equipment - Torch system allowing off-hand (left hand) equipping while maintaining combat ability
[*] Farming Improvements - Carrot farming now yields seeds, expanding agricultural possibilities
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]


Try these new features and much more in our free demo! The demo allows you to experience the early game progression and explore the starting region of Skeleton Island.

[b]How to get started:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Click "Download Demo" on our Steam page
[*] Jump into the adventure
[*] Let us know what you think!
[/olist]


Your feedback shapes the future of Skeleton Island! Join our growing community on Discord to share your thoughts and suggestions: https://discord.gg/dD29kbBEMm


Don't forget to Wishlist Surviving Skeleton Island to stay updated on our journey towards full release. Every wishlist helps our indie team tremendously!


See you on the island, survivors! 🏝️

#SurvivalGame #IndieGame #SteamNextFest #Gaming

notes.title: Surviving Skeleton Island – MAJOR V1.0.9 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello survivors,

As the release of the game nears big changes are happening and the latest V1.0.9 update for Surviving Skeleton Island is here, bringing new content, improvements, and important fixes. This update introduces a new swamp biome, additional mini-boss creatures, improved loot, and various quality-of-life enhancements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485393/757c84ae856bbbc6005eac2826d2bc10bd7b7a2c.png[/img]

Here’s what’s new in this version:

[b]New Content & Features[/b]
[list]
[*] New Swamp Area – Explore the treacherous swamps, now home to new and challenging enemies.
[*] Expanded Survival Options – Additional water sources and camp locations have been added to smaller islands to improve resource gathering.
[*] More Mini Bosses – New Diamond Animals have been introduced, offering tougher encounters and rewarding loot.
[/list]

[b]Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Dungeon 4 (Snow Area) Fixed – Resolved issues preventing proper gameplay in this dungeon.
[*] Harvestable Trees Added – Some small islands now have trees that can be harvested for wood.
[*] Balanced Economy – Adjusted sell values for certain armor and items to improve overall game balance.
[*] Steel Shield Fixed – The shield now functions as intended.
[*] More Readable Items – The “Read” function has been added to additional items, including the Monkey’s Mace.
[/list]

[b]Improved Loot and Treasure:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased loot in dig spots and graves
[*] Adjusted Gazer Island enemies and their loot drops
[*] Increased wood drops from Monkey Island trees
[*] Snake bug fixed – snakes now correctly drop fangs
[*] Map Enhancements – Campfires n
[/list]ow have map icons, making it easier to locate camp locations.

[b]Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Renamed duplicate notes to prevent confusion.
[*] Increased stacking limits for skins and water jugs to improve inventory management.
[*] Bloodstone Portal Fixed – Adjusted to make it easier to open.
[*] Fixed edge-of-game bug – Resolved an issue where players could get stuck at world boundaries.
[/list]

Thank you to all our dedicate testers for playing the game!

Your feedback continues to shape and improve Surviving Skeleton Island. Let us know what you think in the community discussions, and if you’re enjoying the game, consider leaving a review.

See you on Skeleton Island. Stay sharp, and survive.

Bert Games

notes.title: Finally an interactive map and steam achievements for Skeleton Island! (V 1.03)
notes.notes:
[b]Surviving Skeleton Island is now at version 1.03 and ready to launch any day now. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485393/92e3f21e05791d8e409689394957d51852aee933.png[/img]

I took tester feedback onboard and added an interactive map so that its a bit easier to find your way around the island, especially finding quest givers, traders, water, dungeons and other points of interest.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485393/f6c2c793bd4b3dc8a4ef3f228a7a9c53d67c4f8b.png[/img]

I also finally added some steam achievements.  All of them are achievable, but some would take a lot of skill and time to reach end game content to achieve them. I am looking forward seeing who can complete the achievements first!  Who will it be?

Then I made a bunch of other smaller quality of life additions like settings, and options in the menus and worked on a bunch of bug fixes. They never seem to end!  

Look out for a more news in the coming weeks with a launch date if you want to test the beta version of the game before it launches, let me know on Discord.

notes.title: New Update for Skeleton Island - V0.931
notes.notes:
Surviving Skeleton Island is now in full Beta mode (Version 0.931) and progressing nicely. We have some very dedicated testers who are working their way through this challenging game to do indept bug reports and give us suggestions. We are still taking more testers onboard, so find our discord  We are looking at an early access release date before the end of the year. 

Currently the game content is completed up to the end game.  We are just looking to pollish it a bit and add more interesting things to it. We are taking all feedback of our Beta testers on board to make it as fun as possible for everyone.   

[b]Here are some of the latest changes in Version 0.93:[/b]

- added Energy meter.  normal, combo and special attacks and blocking now consume energy, so makes combat more challenging.

-added combo attack for the player

-adding two 2 special attacks for the player, that does massive damage.  Press F or R for special attacks. More energy will be consumed for these.

- improved block mechanic, where you have to hold block to block an attack

- Added bigger variety of drops for the skeletons and goblins

- Added new Goblin camps

Want to help us test the game?  Get in contact on our discord here: https://discord.gg/dD29kbBEMm
